groups: Whole runs by speed; no random row splitting
eligibility: At least5s prior history and100ms future; all requested force samples finite. Fixed10ms block mean reduces source sampling without learned filtering. Signed values retained.
timing: Causal10ms block means sampled100Hz from source1000Hz sequence. At block end t, predict the10ms block ending t+100ms. Every feature uses blocks ending at or before t.
selection: Equal run MAE, simplest coefficient count within1% of best, >=5 adaptive attempts and two final no-gain challenges
exposure: Only headers, frame counts and constant timestamp diagnostics inspected; no reserved force responses viewed. Scientific source is public/source-aware.
